scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,stage,control -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @oar/server" "npm run dev -w @oar/stage" "npm run dev -w @oar/control"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oar/stage && npm run build -w @oar/control && npm run build -w @oar/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @oar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @oar/player && npm run typecheck -w @oar/stage && npm run typecheck -w @oar/control && npm run typecheck -w @oar/server
